requirements.description: The system must provide reports identifying deleted Items that were previously the last copy in a library system or facility, supporting catalogers' WorldCat updates.
requirements.priority_justification: Catalogers can use this report to update WorldCat when a former last copy is deleted, but the system can operate without this specialized historical report.

requirements.name: Identify Purge Candidates
requirements.description: The system must identify item records eligible for purging using customizable, combinable criteria, including status (such as missing, discard/weed, or damaged), time spent in a status, and time since last circulation.
requirements.priority_justification: Customizable purge criteria help staff identify records for collection cleanup, but review and deletion workflows can be delivered separately.
requirements.source_priority_note: D06 marks the last-copy report critical; this note does not apply to purge-candidate identification

requirements.name: Filter Patron Reports
requirements.description: The system must allow patron queries and reports to be limited by age ranges calculated from Patrons' birth dates, ZIP code, county of residence, home Branch, patron type, and preferred language. Users must be able to configure the age brackets used for filtering, including user-defined brackets such as 0–5, 6–10, and 11–15, and combine these filters with other conditions using AND and OR logic.
requirements.priority_justification: D08 and D10 request configurable patron filters that support program planning, while the source’s emphasis on importance does not make this capability necessary for system operation.
requirements.source_priority_note: D08 describes these reports as essential for program planning

requirements.name: Group Patron Reports
requirements.description: The system must group patron queries and reports by age ranges calculated from Patrons' birth dates, ZIP code, county of residence, home Branch, patron type, and preferred language, using configurable age brackets such as 0–5, 6–10, and 11–15, and show aggregates such as circulation counts and patron counts for each group.
requirements.priority_justification: D08 and D10 request demographic groupings and aggregates that support program planning, but the system can run without this specialized analysis.
requirements.source_priority_note: D08 describes these reports as essential for program planning

requirements.name: Include Null Report Values
requirements.description: Report results must include records with null or blank values rather than silently excluding them, including patrons with unpopulated optional demographic fields.
requirements.priority_justification: Including blank values makes results more complete across several reporting contexts, although other system functions do not depend on this behavior.

requirements.name: Add Authorized Canned Reports
requirements.description: Authorized users must be able to add canned reports according to their permissions.
requirements.priority_justification: Adding authorized canned reports lets staff tailor the report catalog to their work, while the existing reports and templates can still support reporting without this capability.

requirements.name: Anonymized Demographic Statistics
requirements.description: The system must produce demographic statistics, including transactions by geographic region and age range, using anonymized data that does not identify individual patrons.
requirements.priority_justification: Anonymized demographic statistics support planning while protecting patron identity, but they are one analytical use of the reporting system.

requirements.name: Associate Financial Records
requirements.description: The system must associate fines, charges, waivers, and ecommerce transactions with Patron and Item records.
requirements.priority_justification: Linking financial records with patron and item records supports useful account and collection analysis, although general reporting can proceed without every such association.

requirements.name: Bibliographic Record Reports
requirements.description: The system must provide periodic management reports identifying bibliographic records with holds and bibliographic records without item records.
requirements.priority_justification: D10 requests periodic checks for records with holds or without items, helping catalogers identify records that may need attention.

requirements.name: Cancel Report Execution
requirements.description: Users must be able to cancel a report that is scheduled or currently running.
requirements.priority_justification: Cancellation helps users recover from unwanted or resource-intensive report runs, but it is a control around execution rather than a reporting prerequisite.

requirements.name: Cataloged and Non-Cataloged Circulation
requirements.description: The system must provide reports of non-cataloged circulation and total circulation, including combined counts for cataloged and non-cataloged circulation.
requirements.priority_justification: Combined cataloged and non-cataloged circulation counts provide a more complete view of use, though reports can still cover cataloged circulation without them.

requirements.name: Circulation Attribute Breakdowns
requirements.description: The system must provide circulation reports broken down by modifier, category, Dewey classification, shelving location, MARC fields, patron county, home library, and age.
requirements.priority_justification: D10, D14, and D20 request circulation breakdowns by operational and patron attributes, providing useful analysis beyond overall totals.

requirements.name: Circulation Transaction Counts
requirements.description: The system must provide circulation reports with individual and cumulative counts for check-ins by book drop, terminal, staff user, and self-service method, distinguish check-ins from renewals in check-in date and time reporting, and count checkouts and renewals by staff checkout, self-checkout, staff renewal, self-checkout renewal, online renewal, and OPAC renewal.
requirements.priority_justification: D10, D14, and D20 request detailed circulation counts that help libraries monitor service activity across staff and self-service channels.

requirements.name: Clone Report Template Variants
requirements.description: Authorized users must be able to clone an existing report template into a separate variant.
requirements.priority_justification: D10, D12, D17, and D20 request cloning templates, allowing authorized users to adapt a report without replacing the original.

requirements.name: Collection Age And Value Reports
requirements.description: The system must provide reports showing collection age or value by call number or shelving location.
requirements.priority_justification: D10 and D14 request collection age and value views that help staff assess materials by call number or shelving location.

requirements.name: Collection Value Reports
requirements.description: The system must report item values based on item-record data for the entire collection or a selected portion, including items selected by status, format, collection, call number, or shelving location.
requirements.priority_justification: Collection value reports can inform budgeting and collection review, though the system can provide its main operational reporting without valuations.

requirements.name: Configuration Migration
requirements.description: The reporting system must provide export and import functionality to migrate configurations, including report templates, permission settings, saved queries, and other configuration, between development or training environments and the production environment.
requirements.priority_justification: D10 assigns configuration migration Medium Priority, and it would simplify moving tested reports and permissions into production, though configurations can be managed manually.
requirements.source_priority_note: D10 marks development and training environments with configuration migration Medium Priority

requirements.name: Create PINES-Wide Templates
requirements.description: Authorized users must be able to create report templates for PINES libraries.
requirements.priority_justification: D10, D12, D17, and D20 request PINES-wide templates so authorized users can share consistent reports across the consortium.

requirements.name: Create Staff Report Templates
requirements.description: Administrators must be able to create report templates that are available to staff.
requirements.priority_justification: D10, D12, D17, and D20 request staff-accessible templates, which can make recurring reports consistent and easier to run.

requirements.name: Cross-Tabulated Activity Reports
requirements.description: The system must provide predefined activity reports containing checkouts, check-ins, holds placed, and holds filled, with cross-tabulation by terminal, Branch, system, hour, Patron age range, Patron type, and Patron location.
requirements.priority_justification: D10, D12, and D18 request cross-tabulated activity reports that help managers analyze service patterns across locations, times, and patron groups.

requirements.name: Current Bills Report
requirements.description: The system must provide a report of bills currently owed by patrons.
requirements.priority_justification: Current-bill reporting in D10 and D14 helps staff and finance teams review patron debts, complementing the fixed payment-audit capability.

requirements.name: Display Report Criteria
requirements.description: The system must display the query selections and clearly defined selection criteria with report results. Results must also identify the report name and selected date criteria.
requirements.priority_justification: Showing criteria with results improves interpretability and reproducibility, though reports can still run without this presentation feature.

requirements.name: Edit Canned Report Fields
requirements.description: Authorized users must be able to edit the display fields of existing canned reports, such as adding shelving location.
requirements.priority_justification: Editing displayed fields helps staff adapt canned reports to local needs, such as including shelving locations, but they can still use reports with their existing fields.

requirements.name: Error Reporting and Feedback
requirements.description: The system must provide high-level error reporting and feedback and low-level query-specific feedback through the front-end interface for Local and Global System Administrators.
requirements.priority_justification: D10 marks administrator error feedback Medium Priority, so it can aid troubleshooting without being necessary for report execution.
requirements.source_priority_note: D10 marks this Medium Priority

requirements.name: Fines and Charges Reports
requirements.description: The system must report fines and charges by time period and charge type.
requirements.priority_justification: D10 and D11 request fines-and-charges reports by period and type, providing useful financial oversight beyond account-level balances.

requirements.name: Group Transaction Reports
requirements.description: The system must group transactions by hour, terminal, branch, and system and support queries for all transactions or transaction types, including check-ins, checkouts, fines collected, and patron registrations.
requirements.priority_justification: Grouping transactions by time and location helps managers analyze activity, but it is one of several useful report dimensions.

requirements.name: Historical Reporting
requirements.description: The system must support reporting on data as it existed at a specified prior date or date range, including historical shelving locations and snapshots of bills. This reporting capability does not prescribe a particular storage architecture.
requirements.priority_justification: Historical snapshots support comparisons and audits across several sources, but the system can deliver current reporting without this capability.

requirements.name: Hold Fulfillment Reports
requirements.description: The system must provide reports of unfilled holds, annual hold counts, and stale holds awaiting pickup.
requirements.priority_justification: D10 and D14 request reports on unfilled, stale, and annual holds, helping staff monitor hold-service performance and follow-up needs.

requirements.name: Hold Shipment Reports
requirements.description: The system must provide reports of items sent or received for holds.
requirements.priority_justification: D10 and D14 request reports of items sent or received for holds, which help staff monitor hold fulfillment between locations.

requirements.name: Identify Material Use
requirements.description: The system must identify the use of uncataloged materials.
requirements.priority_justification: D10 and D15 request identifying use of uncataloged materials, helping libraries assess how those materials are being used.

requirements.name: Item Activity Reports
requirements.description: The system must provide item reports for items added, deleted, edited, counted, currently checked out, overdue, long overdue, missing, in transit, claimed returned, or created within a date range. These item reports must show the last edit date based only on item edits, and circulation activity must not change or be included in that date.
requirements.priority_justification: D10, D14, and D15 request broad item-activity reporting that supports collection management, while other system functions can operate without every listed activity view.

requirements.name: Item Selection And Weeding Reports
requirements.description: The system must provide item reports that select items by use count or fines-stopped reason and provide weeding information.
requirements.priority_justification: D10 and D14 request use-count, fines-stopped, and weeding information that helps staff make collection-maintenance decisions.

requirements.name: Item Usage Reports
requirements.description: The system must report total item-use counts and counts for selected date ranges, including fiscal-year and monthly use, and provide last-circulation dates and weeding data such as date of last circulation and circulation count.
requirements.priority_justification: Item-use and last-circulation data support collection and weeding decisions, but these analyses are not required for other reporting workflows.

requirements.name: Missing MARC Fields
requirements.description: The system must report bibliographic records missing specified MARC fields.
requirements.priority_justification: D10 and D14 request missing-MARC-field checks that help catalogers find incomplete bibliographic data.

requirements.name: Modify Permitted Report Selections
requirements.description: Staff must be able to run report templates as-is or modify only permitted selections, with changes preserving dependable results.
requirements.priority_justification: D10, D12, D17, and D20 request controlled template changes, giving staff flexibility while helping preserve dependable report results.

requirements.name: On-Demand Report Interface
requirements.description: The system must provide an on-demand reporting interface for preset maintenance, collection-development, and similar reports, allowing users to edit selection criteria and display options before execution.
requirements.priority_justification: Editing criteria before execution gives users control over preset reports, though other reporting modes can cover the same general need.

requirements.name: Open Template Reporting
requirements.description: The system must provide open-template reporting with circulation, item, patron, bill, and bibliographic attributes available for filtering and display.
requirements.priority_justification: Open-template reporting makes common data attributes available for flexible analysis, but it is one interface option among several.

requirements.name: Overdue Item Reports
requirements.description: The system must provide reports of overdue items with relevant contact information.
requirements.priority_justification: Overdue-item reports with contact information, requested in D10, D14, and D20, support follow-up on unreturned materials.

requirements.name: Patron Account Balance Reports
requirements.description: The system must report patron account balances by patron, home library, and system.
requirements.priority_justification: D10 and D11 request patron balance reports that help staff and managers review financial obligations at multiple organizational levels.

requirements.name: Patron Count Reports
requirements.description: The system must provide reports for patron counts and patron additions.
requirements.priority_justification: D10 and D14 request patron counts and additions, useful for monitoring service populations and enrollment trends.

requirements.name: Patron Demographic Reports
requirements.description: The system must provide reports of patrons by demographic category, age, county, city, ZIP code, home library, and profile group.
requirements.priority_justification: D10 and D14 request demographic reports across multiple categories, supporting service planning while remaining an analytical rather than operational workflow.

requirements.name: Patron Status Reports
requirements.description: The system must provide reports of patrons by survey response, expiration date, inactive or barred status, and note wording, as well as reports of voter survey responses.
requirements.priority_justification: D10 and D14 request status and survey reports that help staff identify patron-account conditions and review survey responses.

requirements.name: Payment Reports
requirements.description: The system must report payments by time period, payment method, and collecting library.
requirements.priority_justification: D10 and D11 request payment breakdowns by period, method, and collecting library, supporting routine financial review.

requirements.name: Payments Received Report
requirements.description: The system must provide a detailed report of payments received.
requirements.priority_justification: Detailed payment reporting requested in D10 and D14 helps finance staff review receipts alongside the fixed payment ledger.

requirements.name: Prioritize Report Queue
requirements.description: The system must allow designated report types, such as board reports, to be prioritized ahead of lower-priority or resource-consuming reports in the execution queue.
requirements.priority_justification: Queue prioritization can get time-sensitive board reports ahead of resource-intensive jobs, though the sources' emphasis does not make it a core requirement.
requirements.source_priority_note: D12 describes report prioritization as crucial and states that important reports should be able to jump the queue

requirements.name: Process Description Documentation
requirements.description: Product documentation must provide high-level descriptions of major processes, including bibliographic record import and export, validation against internal and external authority sources, and standard reports.
requirements.priority_justification: D10 marks high-level process documentation Medium Priority, making it useful for understanding workflows but less urgent than operating capabilities.
requirements.source_priority_note: D10 marks this Medium Priority

requirements.name: Query Financial Records
requirements.description: The system must support financial queries that join fines, charges, waivers, and ecommerce transactions with Patron and Item records and allow users to query accounts above a specified balance.
requirements.priority_justification: D10 and D11 request joined financial queries, including searches above a balance threshold, to help staff investigate accounts and charges.

requirements.name: Real-Time Reporting
requirements.description: The system must support reports using current data in real time, including reports used to monitor current activity.
requirements.priority_justification: Current-data reports help monitor live activity, but not every management report requires real-time results.

requirements.name: Records Without Volumes
requirements.description: The system must report bibliographic records without attached volumes.
requirements.priority_justification: D10 and D14 request identifying records without volumes, helping catalogers find collection gaps and cleanup needs.

requirements.name: Report Output Formats
requirements.description: The system must provide reports in Excel, HTML, CSV, and pivot-table formats.
requirements.priority_justification: Multiple output formats make results easier to analyze and share, but the reporting system can operate with a narrower set of formats.

requirements.name: Report Queue Visibility
requirements.description: Staff must be able to view their report's queue position, the number of reports ahead, submission time, and status, including waiting, running, completed, or failed.
requirements.priority_justification: Queue status helps staff understand report progress across several sources, but it does not determine whether reports can execute.

requirements.name: Report Uncataloged Material Transactions
requirements.description: The system must include transactions involving uncataloged materials in circulation statistics and reports.
requirements.priority_justification: D10 and D15 request including uncataloged transactions in circulation statistics, helping avoid incomplete activity reporting.

requirements.name: Run and Schedule Canned Reports
requirements.description: The system must provide canned reports that users can run immediately or schedule to run ASAP, hourly, daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly. Users must be able to edit recurring reports by adding or removing report selections and changing the report's email recipients.
requirements.priority_justification: D10, D14, and D20 request reusable canned reports with scheduling, reducing repeated staff effort while leaving basic reporting possible without automation.

requirements.name: Separate System Environments
requirements.description: The system must provide separate development, training, and production environments, with the training environment allowing staff to practice without risking production data.
requirements.priority_justification: D10 marks development and training environments with configuration migration as Medium Priority, and D16, D18, and D19 also request separate environments for safer practice and testing.
requirements.source_priority_note: D10 marks development and training environments with configuration migration Medium Priority

requirements.name: Single-Row MARC Reporting
requirements.description: The system must extract selected MARC fields for reports and display those fields on a single row of report data, including when the fields are stored across multiple rows.
requirements.priority_justification: Single-row MARC extraction makes selected bibliographic fields easier to use in reports, but it is a specialized data presentation need.

requirements.name: Staff Login Methods
requirements.description: The system must support individual staff authentication using traditional username and password and an optional streamlined method such as an employee-card swipe. Card-based login must not be required or bypass individual authentication, and the system must identify which staff member is logged in.
requirements.priority_justification: Individual authentication and staff identification support accountable access, while the optional card method remains a convenience.

requirements.name: State-Aid Statistics Reports
requirements.description: The system must provide predefined reports for library boards and other external consumers containing the basic statistics required by the Georgia Annual Report and Application for State Aid.
requirements.priority_justification: D10, D12, and D18 request predefined statistics for boards and state-aid reporting, reducing the effort to assemble those external reports.

requirements.name: Table and Field Access Control
requirements.description: The system must allow administrators to control staff access to tables and fields.
requirements.priority_justification: Table- and field-level controls add useful protection for sensitive data, while the fixed role-based access requirements provide a broader security foundation.

requirements.name: Track Library Payments
requirements.description: The system must track fines waived and payments by library.
requirements.priority_justification: D10 and D11 request tracking waivers and payments by library, providing useful local financial oversight.

requirements.name: Track Uncataloged Material Inventory
requirements.description: The system must track uncataloged materials, including paperback books and children's board books, as inventory before individual catalog records are complete.
requirements.priority_justification: D10 and D15 request inventory tracking for uncataloged materials, allowing branches to account for materials before individual records are complete.

requirements.name: Transaction History Retention
requirements.description: The system must retain detailed transaction history for a configurable number of days and retain monthly and annual aggregate information indefinitely.
requirements.priority_justification: Retaining detailed and aggregate transactions supports historical analysis, but the requested retention policy is not identified as a legal obligation here.

requirements.name: Transaction Summary Reports
requirements.description: The system must report holds placed, holds filled, and checkouts per patron, library, selected group of libraries, system, or county. Reports must display checkout and placed-hold counts per patron and subtotal holds by type, including active, frozen, and frozen-until holds.
requirements.priority_justification: These summaries help compare hold and checkout activity across organizational scopes, but they are one analytical report family.

requirements.name: Update Financial Information
requirements.description: The system must allow financial information to be updated and reflected promptly.
requirements.priority_justification: Promptly reflected financial updates help keep reports and account review current, though the requirement is limited to the financial workflow.

requirements.name: Waived Fine Reports
requirements.description: The system must report fines waived by time period and Branch.
requirements.priority_justification: D10 and D11 request waived-fine reporting by time and branch, helping managers review an important part of library financial activity.

requirements.name: Workstation Transaction Reports
requirements.description: The system must report transactions by specified date and time, workstation, or staff member to support analysis of activity and staff workflow.
requirements.priority_justification: Workstation- and staff-level transaction reports help analyze activity and workflow, though the system can provide general transaction reporting without them.

requirements.name: Vendor Data Integration
requirements.description: The system must support data exchange with vendor websites through published APIs or automated transfers of standard-format data files, including USMARC21 and EDIFACT, while accommodating locations where particular vendor data is unavailable.
requirements.priority_justification: Vendor data exchange supports purchasing and processing workflows, but the request is limited to two sources and allows locations without particular vendor data.

requirements.name: Prevent Duplicate Export Rows
requirements.description: Report exports must avoid unintended duplicate rows so exported data can be used without repeated records.
requirements.priority_justification: Preventing unintended duplicate export rows improves the usability of exported data, though the single-source feature does not block other report functions.

requirements.name: Alert Transfer Problems
requirements.description: The system must notify responsible staff when an item transfer is delayed or encounters an issue.
requirements.priority_justification: Problem alerts can help staff respond sooner, but delayed-transfer notification is a single-source convenience rather than a prerequisite for tracking transfers.

requirements.name: Print Transit Labels
requirements.description: The system must generate printable transit labels containing barcodes for items being transferred.
requirements.priority_justification: Barcode transit labels can simplify physical handling, but staff can move items without this single-source printing feature.

requirements.name: Share Transfer Queries
requirements.description: The system must allow authorized users to share saved transfer queries with other authorized users.
requirements.priority_justification: Sharing queries is a convenience for teams, but the single-source request does not make it necessary for users to run their own transfer queries.

requirements.name: Undo Completed Transfers
requirements.description: The system must allow an authorized user to undo an item transfer when an incorrect transfer has been completed.
requirements.priority_justification: Undoing a completed transfer is a useful recovery option, but it is a single-source safeguard rather than a core reporting capability.

requirements.name: Review Purge Candidates
requirements.description: The system must provide read-only reports of item records identified as purge candidates so users can review them without changing or deleting records through the reports.
requirements.priority_justification: Read-only candidate reports provide a convenient review step, but the request appears in only D06 and is not required to identify candidates.

requirements.name: Report Deletion Activity
requirements.description: The system must report deletion activity for a selected period, including totals and breakdowns by record type, location, system, and user, and identify users with the highest deletion counts.
requirements.priority_justification: Deletion activity summaries help administrators review patterns, but the single-source request is an additional analysis rather than a core workflow.

requirements.name: Track Denied Deletions
requirements.description: The system must track deletion attempts that are denied so administrators can identify attempted deletions of records that users should not delete.
requirements.priority_justification: Tracking denied attempts can help administrators investigate unusual behavior, but it is requested only in D07 and does not block ordinary deletion auditing.

requirements.name: Bibliographic Record Counts
requirements.description: The system must report counts of bibliographic records, including records added by each user and library.
requirements.priority_justification: Bibliographic record counts by user and library are a useful management metric, but this specific report appears in only D10 and D14.

requirements.name: Combine Reports Into Documents
requirements.description: The system must allow users to select multiple canned reports to run together and view their results in one document.
requirements.priority_justification: Combining canned reports into one document is a convenience requested in D10, D14, and D20, but separate report results remain usable.

requirements.name: Comparative Report Columns
requirements.description: The system must support report outputs with comparative columns for periods such as last month's circulation, the previous month's circulation, percentage difference, the corresponding month of the previous year, and percentage difference between those periods.
requirements.priority_justification: Comparative period columns can make trends easier to interpret, but this is a specialized output enhancement.

requirements.name: Edited Record Counts
requirements.description: The system must report counts of edited bibliographic records.
requirements.priority_justification: Edited-record counts provide a narrow staff-activity measure requested in D10 and D14, and the system can operate without it.

requirements.name: Email Report Delivery
requirements.description: The system must allow users to deliver reports by email, enter recipients, and select recipients from an address book of regularly used addresses.
requirements.priority_justification: Email delivery and saved recipients add convenience, but users can retrieve and share reports through other means.

requirements.name: Filter Surveys By Name
requirements.description: Users must be able to select a survey by its name rather than entering its identifier, and the system must resolve the name to the corresponding survey record.
requirements.priority_justification: Selecting surveys by name is a usability improvement for a narrow report filter, and users can otherwise enter the identifier.

requirements.name: Forgive Work Goods Report
requirements.description: The system must provide a detailed report of forgive, work, and goods payments.
requirements.priority_justification: This specialized breakdown of forgive, work, and goods payments is requested in D10 and D14 but is narrower than general payment reporting.

requirements.name: Hold Purchase Alert Reports
requirements.description: The system must provide reports identifying hold purchase alerts.
requirements.priority_justification: Hold purchase alert reports are a narrow operational report requested only in D10 and D14.

requirements.name: In-House Use Reports
requirements.description: The system must report non-cataloged in-house use counts by month and cataloged in-house use counts.
requirements.priority_justification: In-house use counts add a limited view of material use, but the request appears only in D10 and other circulation reports remain available.

requirements.name: IntraPINES Loan Reports
requirements.description: The system must provide reports of IntraPINES loans by system or facility.
requirements.priority_justification: IntraPINES loan reports are a specialized reporting need requested in D10 and D14, and are not needed for general reporting workflows.

requirements.name: Notice Activity Reports
requirements.description: The system must support reports on pre-overdue notices, overdue notices, and holds notices sent.
requirements.priority_justification: Notice activity reports provide a useful service snapshot, but this limited report family is only specified in D10.

requirements.name: Patron Behavior Statistics
requirements.description: The system must produce statistics for understanding and predicting patron behavior and material use, including average return speed for a particular book, likelihood of renewal, renewal rates, and the percentage of branch checkouts that are renewals.
requirements.priority_justification: Predictive behavior measures can inform planning, but the specialized statistics are requested by only two sources and are not core operations.

requirements.name: Patron Library Validation Reports
requirements.description: The system must provide periodic management reports identifying patrons with invalid home libraries.
requirements.priority_justification: Invalid-home-library checks are a useful data-cleanup report, but this specific request appears only in D10.

requirements.name: Report Hold Placement Methods
requirements.description: The system must count hold requests and report how each hold was placed, including at a staff desk, at a public computer inside the library, or remotely.
requirements.priority_justification: Hold-placement channels offer a useful service-use breakdown, but the single-source detail is not necessary for hold reporting generally.

requirements.name: Staff Account Reports
requirements.description: The system must provide reports of staff accounts by password-change date and account expiration.
requirements.priority_justification: Staff-account reports on password changes and expiration are a useful administrative check, but the specific reporting need appears only in D10 and D14.

requirements.name: Upload Report Filters
requirements.description: Users must be able to upload a text file containing values such as barcodes or TCNs and use those values to filter a report.
requirements.priority_justification: Uploading barcode or TCN filters can save time for selected tasks, but users can filter reports through other query methods.

requirements.name: Voids Report
requirements.description: The system must provide a detailed report of voids.
requirements.priority_justification: A dedicated voids report is a useful financial review tool, but D10 and D14 request it as a specialized report rather than a core workflow.

requirements.name: Aged Debt Report
requirements.description: The system must provide an aged-debt report with detailed debt information.
requirements.priority_justification: The aged-debt report is requested only in D14 and is a specialized extension of current-bill reporting.

requirements.name: Data Quality Validation Reports
requirements.description: The system must provide periodic management reports identifying data-quality problems, including Items with invalid item types, Items with excessively long call numbers, and bibliographic records without item records.
requirements.priority_justification: Requested across three source documents, these reports help staff identify and correct catalog data problems, though they are not needed for routine reporting to function.

requirements.name: Batch Item Status Conversion
requirements.description: The system must support converting multiple Items from one status to another in a batch, such as changing Items from missing to discard or weed.
requirements.priority_justification: The three source documents support batch status changes as a useful collection-management workflow, while staff can still change item statuses individually without it.

requirements.name: Status Conversion Assistance
requirements.description: The system must provide a report or workflow to assist with converting multiple Items from one status to another.
requirements.priority_justification: Requested in three source documents, this workflow would help staff identify items for status conversion, while the conversion task itself can be handled through other means.

requirements.name: Generate Inactive Patron Reports
requirements.description: The system must generate lists of patrons with no circulation or electronic activity during a configurable number of days. Electronic activity includes account or OPAC logins, online holds, online renewals, and logged access to integrated digital collections. Users must be able to select System, Home Library, County, or another required organizational level, include current mailing addresses, separately identify patrons with outstanding fines, and exclude specified categories such as do-not-disturb, VIP, staff, or opted-out patrons.
requirements.priority_justification: These reports help libraries review inactive accounts and outstanding fines at useful organizational levels, although they are a specialized management task.

requirements.name: Export Inactive Patron Results
requirements.description: The system must allow users to export inactive patron report results to CSV.
requirements.priority_justification: CSV export makes inactive-patron results easier to analyze and share, but the report remains usable without this additional output option.

requirements.name: Process Reports in Background
requirements.description: The system must support background processing of inactive patron reports and retrieval of completed results.
requirements.priority_justification: Background processing helps staff retrieve results without waiting on a long-running inactive-patron report, though this report-specific convenience builds on broader processing capabilities.

requirements.name: Client Access Platforms and Browsers
requirements.description: The system must be accessible through a web browser or a Windows-compatible client; when accessed through a web browser, it must support Microsoft Internet Explorer version 6.0 or later and Mozilla Firefox version 2.0 or later.
requirements.priority_justification: D10 marks Client Access Platforms as High Priority, making support for the specified client access methods a stated high-priority source requirement.
requirements.source_priority_note: D10 marks Client Access Platforms as High Priority and Supported Web Browsers as Medium Priority

glossary.definition: A library location within a library system or consortium.
A group of library systems or locations sharing the library automation and management reporting environment.
A physical library copy represented by an item record.
Machine-Readable Cataloging, the record format used to represent bibliographic data.
The Online Public Access Catalog through which patrons access library catalog services.
A person who uses a library's resources or services.
A reusable report definition with specified selection criteria and display options.

requirement.name: Efficient Batch Processing
requirement.description: The system must process batch location updates efficiently for an inventory of approximately 9.6 million items and avoid database locking problems by processing updates in smaller batches.

blacklist.reason: The candidate prescribes implementation and performance handling (smaller batches and avoidance of database locking) rather than a distinct user-facing capability or testable system quality. D04 mentions this only as a technical concern; the transfer capability is retained separately.

requirement.name: Report Output Validation
requirement.description: Report output must be tested and proven accurate for its intended reporting purpose.

blacklist.reason: This is a testing and QA process, not a capability or quality stated as a product behavior. D10's specification text calls for tested and proven output, but the candidate does not define a testable product requirement.

requirement.name: Centralized Multi-Location Service
requirement.description: Management Processes must be consolidated at a central location that accepts input from and provides services to multiple library locations, supporting a single source of truth for reporting.

blacklist.reason: D19 labels central consolidation as an assumption rather than a required system capability; the source does not make this an explicit product requirement.

requirement.name: Enterprise ILS Integration
requirement.description: The management processes must use the data structures and functionality of an enterprise-level Library Automation System, including its Acquisitions and Cataloging modules, rather than independently managing those functions.

blacklist.reason: D18 presents this as an assumption and dependency on the enterprise library system, not as a capability required of the reporting product.

requirement.name: Library Automation Integration
requirement.description: Management Processes must rely on and read the data structures and functionality of the enterprise-level Library Automation System, including its Acquisitions and Cataloging modules, without managing acquisitions or cataloging data.

blacklist.reason: D19 presents this as an assumption and dependency on the enterprise library system, not as a capability required of the reporting product.

requirement.name: Distribute Materials Rapidly
requirement.description: The system must support rapid distribution of uncataloged materials with minimal Branch labor.
requirement.priority_justification: D10 and D15 request rapid distribution with minimal branch labor, improving handling of uncataloged materials while not replacing core circulation workflows.

blacklist.reason: Distribute Materials Rapidly is discarded because its sources, D10 and D15, support the general goals of rapid distribution and minimal Branch labor but do not specify a concrete system capability or testable measure for either outcome.

open_questions.question: What specific metrics or configured limits define branch capacity?
How should shelf space be estimated when measurements are not directly tracked: from item dimensions, item count, or another method?
Should checkout at a transfer destination trigger automatic reversion, or should checked-out items remain there while unused items revert?
What threshold should be used for the delayed in-transit report beyond the suggested configurable default of seven days?
Which electronic activities count toward inactivity when digital-resource access is not integrated or logged?
How many years must transaction data be retained under applicable State law?
